note: Working protocol frozen before running count, parsing or ciphertext-border program. Not blind to crib lengths, which were already known and considered during research. Not a repository preregistration.

codecs.edition: cmusphinx/cmudict commit 74790861f652b15e4ac49015a90074ad62a27690; current proxy, not pre-1990 dictionary

raw.NORTHEAST: N AO2 R TH IY1 S T

codecs.alternates: No numbered alternatives for the five headwords in frozen dictionary
codecs.normalization: Split on ASCII spaces; remove final stress digit 0,1,2 from each vowel token; concatenate tokens. Stress retained additionally as an audit representation, not another cipher candidate.
codecs.domain: 39 base phones; 69 stressed lexical phone labels (24 consonants + 15 vowels times 3 stress levels); source symbols file additionally lists 15 bare vowels, hence 84 entries.

codecs.edition: English SAMPA as documented in EAGLES 1995 section A.1.2, with Cambridge current UK lexical entries
codecs.alternates: One UK entry per word on frozen Cambridge pages. US entries are a different dialect model, not mixed into this one.
codecs.normalization: Remove IPA stress ˈ and ˌ, separators / . hyphen and spaces; retain length; convert each IPA token using fixed English SAMPA mapping iː=i:, ɔː=O:, θ=T, ɜː=3:, ɪ=I, ɒ=Q; unchanged b,k,l,n,s,t.
codecs.domain: 44 English phoneme tokens (24 consonants, 20 vowels); optional weak-vowel indeterminacy i,u in the source are excluded from this lexical subset, not silently collapsed.

codecs.edition: American Heritage Dictionary Fifth Edition online, copyright 2022; present-day proxy
codecs.alternates: Both entire NORTHEAST alternatives retained. BERLIN is the city entry, not the carriage or personal-name entries.
codecs.normalization: NFC; strip enclosing parentheses, lexical syllable hyphen, primary stress U+E01F and secondary prime U+2032 if present; omit interword spaces. Retain every diacritic and th digraph.
codecs.token_note: These are explicitly chart-key units using composite ôr and ûr, not asserted physical phones or Unicode glyphs. AHD th is one key unit and two characters.

counts: For each whole raw lexical entry and joined normalized stream report chart/phone tokens, NFC Unicode code points, UTF-8 bytes, observed character inventory and observed token inventory. Raw lexical concatenations exclude interword separators but preserve internal source punctuation; raw ARPABET retains token spaces.
tests: Verify fixed token arrays join to normalized source-derived streams.
Check same-unit one-to-one A-Z feasibility against local lengths 13 and 11; do not equate code points and phones.

Check source-prefix/suffix EAST token repetition, and target proper borders of FLRVQQPRNGKSS. A deterministic non-erasing concatenative token code preserves that border regardless of variable codeword length. No outer key, shifts or cipher enumeration.
Run codec roundtrip controls for explicit framed token arrays, and construct unframed ambiguity witnesses NG versus N+G and tS versus t+S.
Demonstrate known lexical phonetic ambiguity with CMU NIGHT/KNIGHT in the same snapshot, not a selected phrase recovery.
alignment: A fixed 13-letter first and 11-letter second ciphertext block is conditional: public orthographic positions do not prove transformed-stream positions. A variable-length outer serialization generally moves starts to |f(A)| and |f(A)|+|f(EASTNORTHEAST)|+|f(B)|; these are unknown. No freely shifted crib is tested.
stopping: Stop after counts, source inventory, parsing controls and border certificate. No whole K4 solution, key search, period rerun, soundex/metaphone or arbitrary replacement spellings.
